description: This file implements a server handler for managing parallel test execution in the Ginkgo testing framework, including coordination of suite lifecycle events, output handling, and process health checks.

classes.name: ServerHandler
classes.description: Handles coordination of parallel test suite execution, including reporting, process health, and lifecycle events.

classes.name: Void
classes.description: An empty struct used for RPC method signatures.

methods.name: newServerHandler
methods.description: Creates a new ServerHandler instance with specified parallelism and reporter.

methods.name: SpecSuiteWillBegin
methods.description: Handles the start of a test suite, triggering reporting.

methods.name: DidRun
methods.description: Handles the completion of an individual test spec, updating reports.

methods.name: SpecSuiteDidEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of a test suite, aggregating reports and signaling completion.

methods.name: EmitOutput
methods.description: Outputs data to the designated output destination.

methods.name: procIsAlive
methods.description: Checks if a process is alive.

methods.name: haveNonprimaryProcsFinished
methods.description: Checks if all non-primary processes have finished.

methods.name: ReportBeforeSuiteCompleted
methods.description: Reports completion of the before suite phase.

methods.name: ReportBeforeSuiteState
methods.description: Retrieves the current before suite state.

methods.name: HaveNonprimaryProcsFinished
methods.description: Checks if non-primary processes have finished.

methods.name: AggregatedNonprimaryProcsReport
methods.description: Provides aggregated report of non-primary processes.

methods.name: Counter
methods.description: Returns current counter value and increments it.

methods.name: Abort
methods.description: Signals to abort the test run.

methods.name: ShouldAbort
methods.description: Checks if an abort has been signaled.
